How sleep is calculated

Frequently asked questions

Are sleep cycles exactly 90 minutes?

No. Cycle duration varies, so treat the times as rough planning anchors.

How much sleep should I target?

Needs vary by age and health; follow reputable clinical guidance rather than optimizing only for cycle count.
